verdicts.proof: Old: AppShell passes isActive: i == index (app_shell.dart:122-129, index from _currentIndex :30-43 where /booking, /payment, /moto/* = 1 and /reservations/* = 2); onShellTabTap navigates only if !isActive || goHome (shell_tab_action.dart:42-47); 4.1.3 had the same i != index rule. v2: AppShellV2._onTab (app_shell_v2.dart:137-151) treats a tap as reselect only when path == tab root (:140), otherwise calls onShellTabTap with isActive:false (:149). So on /booking, /payment (when not processing), /moto/:id a tap on highlighted Motorky goes to /search; in /reservations/:id or /reservations/:id/edit a tap on Rezervace goes to the list. Running payment still asks confirm (shell_tab_action.dart:29-37), and v2 keeps the booking draft in memory, so impact is low, but the original 'tap on the lit tab does nothing' protection is gone.
verdicts.fix_idea: In AppShellV2._onTab: when i == v2TabIndexFor(path) and path != route, do nothing (return) instead of navigating, or pass isActive: i == v2TabIndexFor(path) to onShellTabTap; keep the root-reselect scroll-to-top as is.

Whether the booking form re-validates availability of the kept bike/dates on re-entry was not traced here.
